# sreagent_compliance_periods (Data Source)

Every compliance_period row, read-only. Audit windows; immutable once opened.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_compliance_periods" "all" {}

output "compliance_periods_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_compliance_periods.all.items)
}
```
